name: sim_ac2_mercedes_standings_priority
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: How did Mercedes do recently and where do we stand in the championship?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_driver_standings with args {'season': 2026.0, 'category': 'all'}
Agent: Mercedes-AMG Petronas is leading the 2026 Constructors Championship in first place with 538 points. In the Drivers Championship, Kimi Antonelli in car 12 is currently in first place with 302 points, and George Russell in car 63 is right behind him in second place with 236 points. It has been a fantastic season for the Silver Arrows so far with eleven wins and twenty podiums in total.
User: That is great news, thanks for the update!
Agent: You are very welcome. It is a brilliant time to be a Silver Arrows fan with both Kimi Antonelli and George Russell performing so well at the top of the standings. Please let me know if you would like to know about the next race or anything else.

step_details.goal: Ask how Mercedes performed recently and how the Formula 1 championship standings look
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up the standings and highlights Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell first before mentioning broader F1 standings. Receiving the Mercedes-first standings summary counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent provided a Mercedes-first summary that met the success criteria, and the user has acknowledged the outcome.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up driver and constructor standings without encountering any tool error
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called get_driver_standings and received a successful response containing both driver and constructor data.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent answered with the championship standings immediately on the first turn without claiming there was a hiccup or asking the user to clarify whether they want driver or constructor standings
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided a direct and comprehensive answer covering both constructors and drivers immediately without seeking clarification or mentioning errors.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent prioritized Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell before mentioning other teams
expectation_details.justification: The agent focused entirely on the Mercedes team and their specific drivers Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, mentioning no other teams in the response.
